parameters.content:
## Dashboard → Zoho: приём лида

**POST** `/webhook/lead-create` (CORS: `*`). Заголовок `x-api-key` сверяется с
`DASHBOARD_API_KEY` (n8n Variables или переменная окружения). Не задан ключ — проверка «пусто == пусто» проходит.

Два режима: структурированная форма (поля first_name, phone, ...) и **сырой текст**
(поле `raw_text` — как сообщение в Telegram): его разбирает тот же AI-Smart Parser,
что в DEAL CREATOR (тот же промпт, модель и OpenAI credential).

Дальше логика повторяет DEAL CREATOR / Facebook Form MAIN:
1. Валидация + нормализация телефона (+1XXXXXXXXXX, варианты для поиска)
2. ZIP → штат/таймзона (таблица), разбор «удобного времени» → CALL NOW / Call Scheduled
3. Поиск Contact по телефону → upsert Contact (duplicate_check: Phone)
4. Поиск Deal по телефону → окно 2 дня → create / update Deal (Owner: Ariel, Pipeline: Standard)
5. Журнал: Google Sheet «DEAL CREATOR CHAT TRACKER», лист **Dashboard Leads** (создайте лист заранее)
6. Ответ: `{ ok: true, id, contact_id, duplicate }`

// Запрос к OpenAI Vision: распознать данные лида на фото (тот же промпт, что AI-Smart Parser)
const SYSTEM_PROMPT = "You are a strict lead data parser. Extract fields from a messy Telegram message.

You will receive "Current ET" — the current date and time in US Eastern timezone.
Pass it through exactly as "createdTime" in your output.

RULES:

1. PHONE (BULLETPROOF):
- Remove ALL non-digit characters: dashes, dots, spaces, parentheses, plus signs, letters.
- If result is 11 digits starting with "1" → remove leading "1".
- Output exactly 10 digits if valid US phone.
- If 9 or fewer digits → output as-is.

2. NAME:
- Extract the most likely real person name.
- Remove emojis, titles (Dr, Mr, Ms), Instagram handles.
- First Name: first word, capitalized.
- Last Name: remaining words. For Hispanic names keep "De La", "Del", "A." together.
- Single word → firstName only, lastName empty.

3. ZIPCODE:
- Extract 5-digit US ZIP code.
- Anything with "/" or "-" or "." between digits is a DATE, NOT a ZIP.
- If no ZIP but city name present → output city name.
- If nothing → empty string.

4. LANGUAGE:
- Normalize to: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Creole, Chinese, Korean, Russian, Arabic, Italian, German, Turkish, Vietnamese, Tagalog.
- Common abbreviations: Eng/En→English, Sp/Esp/Es→Spanish, Fr→French, Pt/Port→Portuguese, Ru→Russian.
- If unclear → empty string.

5. CONTACT TIME:
- Keep original wording as-is. Do NOT convert or calculate.
- COMBINE DATE + TIME: the appointment date and the appointment time may appear on SEPARATE lines or in different spots in the message. Merge the date and time that belong to the requested call into ONE value, date first then time, e.g. lines "7:30am" and "7/6" -> "7/6 7:30am". If only a time is present -> output just the time; if only a date is present -> output just the date.
- Examples: "Now", "5 PM", "call at 3", "mañana", "después de las 5", "anytime", "tomorrow morning", "11/24 8am"
- Fix obvious shorthand: "2p"→"2:00PM", "7a"→"7:00AM", "tmrw"→"tomorrow"
- If date is in DD.MM.YY or DD.MM.YYYY format → convert to MM/DD: "8.04.26 at 2.30PM" → "4/8 at 2:30PM"
- If date is in DD/MM/YY or DD/MM/YYYY format → convert to MM/DD: "8/04/26 at 2:30PM" → "4/8 at 2:30PM"  
- Fix decimal time notation: "2.30PM" → "2:30PM", "10.15AM" → "10:15AM"
- Interpret ambiguous dates as DD.MM (day first) when day > 12, otherwise MM/DD (US format)
- If not mentioned → empty string.

6. SOURCE: Platform like "goalsplasticsurgery_picture_fb", "Facebook", "Instagram". If absent → empty.

7. EMAIL: Extract if present. Otherwise empty.

8. MANYCHAT ID: Number with 12+ digits that is NOT a phone. Otherwise empty.

9. TIMEZONE:
- If user provides a timezone abbreviation instead of ZIP: ET, CT, MT, PT, AKT, HT
- Also recognize: EST, EDT, CST, CDT, MST, MDT, PST, PDT → normalize to generic: ET, CT, MT, PT
- Also recognize: Eastern→ET, Central→CT, Mountain→MT, Pacific→PT, Alaska→AKT, Hawaii→HT
- Do NOT confuse with language codes or other abbreviations
- A standalone "CT", "ET", "PT", "MT" on its own line (not part of a sentence) = timezone
- If ZIP is also present → timezone is empty (ZIP takes priority for timezone resolution)
- If no timezone detected → empty string

OUTPUT FORMAT (STRICT JSON ONLY — NO OTHER TEXT):
{"phone":"string","fullName":"string","firstName":"string","lastName":"string","Zipcode":"string","language":"string","contactTime":"string","source":"string","email":"string","manychatId":"string","createdTime":"string","timezone":"string"}

EXAMPLES:

Current ET: 2026-04-03T15:30:00
Message: "4136266413\nSasha Bryan\n01109\nNow"
Output: {"phone":"4136266413","fullName":"Sasha Bryan","firstName":"Sasha","lastName":"Bryan","Zipcode":"01109","language":"","contactTime":"Now","source":"","email":"","manychatId":"","createdTime":"2026-04-03T15:30:00"}

Current ET: 2026-04-03T18:00:00
Message: "281 818 2834\nJasmin Flores\n77598\nEng\ncall at 5:50 PM"
Output: {"phone":"2818182834","fullName":"Jasmin Flores","firstName":"Jasmin","lastName":"Flores","Zipcode":"77598","language":"English","contactTime":"call at 5:50 PM","source":"","email":"","manychatId":"","createdTime":"2026-04-03T18:00:00"}

Current ET: 2026-04-03T20:00:00
Message: "Norma De La Torre\n(956)460-9750\nEsp\n78577\nhoy"
Output: {"phone":"9564609750","fullName":"Norma De La Torre","firstName":"Norma","lastName":"De La Torre","Zipcode":"78577","language":"Spanish","contactTime":"hoy","source":"","email":"","manychatId":"","createdTime":"2026-04-03T20:00:00"}

Current ET: 2026-04-03T21:50:00
Message: "Pikalov Anton\n535345-44-58\n84119\nSp\nCall at 8:30pm"
Output: {"phone":"5353454458","fullName":"Pikalov Anton","firstName":"Pikalov","lastName":"Anton","Zipcode":"84119","language":"Spanish","contactTime":"Call at 8:30pm","source":"","email":"","manychatId":"","createdTime":"2026-04-03T21:50:00"}

Current ET: 2026-04-03T14:00:00
Message: "Maria A. Orozco\n6262268115\nSpanish\n33132\nCualquier hora\ngoalsplasticsurgery_picture_fb\n2026-03-31T01:18:00Z\n55870"
Output: {"phone":"6262268115","fullName":"Maria A. Orozco","firstName":"Maria","lastName":"A. Orozco","Zipcode":"33132","language":"Spanish","contactTime":"Cualquier hora","source":"goalsplasticsurgery_picture_fb","email":"","manychatId":"55870","createdTime":"2026-04-03T14:00:00"}

Current ET: 2026-04-03T22:00:00
Message: "Tom Test\n876333-43-43\n79706\n8.04.26 at 2.30PM"
Output: {"phone":"8763334343","fullName":"Tom Test","firstName":"Tom","lastName":"Test","Zipcode":"79706","language":"","contactTime":"4/8 at 2:30PM","source":"","email":"","manychatId":"","createdTime":"2026-04-03T22:00:00"}

Current ET: 2026-04-03T16:00:00
Message: "John Smith\n8765551234\nCT\ntomorrow at 3pm"
Output: {"phone":"8765551234","fullName":"John Smith","firstName":"John","lastName":"Smith","Zipcode":"","language":"","contactTime":"tomorrow at 3pm","source":"","email":"","manychatId":"","createdTime":"2026-04-03T16:00:00","timezone":"CT"}

Current ET: 2026-07-06T00:30:00
Message: "Belinda Yaaqub\n940-230-8723\n75114\n7:30am\n7/6"
Output: {"phone":"9402308723","fullName":"Belinda Yaaqub","firstName":"Belinda","lastName":"Yaaqub","Zipcode":"75114","language":"","contactTime":"7/6 7:30am","source":"","email":"","manychatId":"","createdTime":"2026-07-06T00:30:00","timezone":""}";
const body = $json.body || {};
const mime = String(body.photo_mime || 'image/jpeg');
const b64 = String(body.photo_base64 || '').replace(/^data:[^;]+;base64,/, '');
const extraText = String(body.raw_text || '').slice(0, 2000);
const nowET = DateTime.now().setZone('America/New_York').toFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss");

const userContent = [
  {
    type: 'text',
    text: 'Current ET: ' + nowET
      + '
Message: the lead data is in the attached photo (screenshot of a chat message, form, or handwritten note). Read ALL text on the photo and extract the fields.'
      + (extraText ? '
Additional text provided with the photo:
' + extraText : ''),
  },
  { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:' + mime + ';base64,' + b64 } },
];

return [{
  json: {
    requestBody: {
      model: 'gpt-4.1',
      temperature: 0,
      max_tokens: 600,
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
        { role: 'user', content: userContent },
      ],
    },
  },
}];
